description: Report Claude Code lifecycle state and turns to tmux-agent-tools.

hooks.command: if [ -n "$TMUX" ] && cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)" && [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook claude SessionStart; fi
if [ -n "$TMUX" ] && cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)" && [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook claude UserPromptSubmit; fi
if [ -n "$TMUX" ] && cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)" && [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook claude PermissionRequest; fi
if [ -n "$TMUX" ] && cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)" && [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook claude PostToolBatch; fi
if [ -n "$TMUX" ] && cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)" && [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook claude Stop; fi
if [ -n "$TMUX" ] && cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)" && [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook claude StopFailure; fi
if [ -n "$TMUX" ] && cli="$(tmux show -gqv @agent-cli 2>/dev/null)" && [ -n "$cli" ]; then "$cli" hook claude SessionEnd; fi
